title: Gain (counted savings)
summary: Sums the per-user usage log: tokens returned versus source bytes avoided, per verb and per day
intro: Read this to see what the index saves: gain sums the usage log that context, query and find-callers append to, per verb and per day, as tokens returned against the source they stood in for.

help: drag-lint gain               [--since yyyy-mm-dd] [--json]   (counted savings: sums %LOCALAPPDATA%\drag-lint\usage.log -- one line per context / query / find-callers run, written best effort; DRAGLINT_USAGE_LOG=0 turns the log off -- per verb and per day: tokens_returned, tokens_avoided = source bytes the answer stood in for / 4, ratio)

pitfalls: tokens_returned is measured only for context and query --text; the other readers are estimated at 15 tokens per row
The log is per user and best effort: an unwritable LOCALAPPDATA loses lines silently by design

questions.ask: How many tokens has the index saved me this week?
